rules.text: A bank may open a cross-bank case only about its own customer who shows at least 2 objective red-flag indicators.
A bank answers questions about its own customer only if its own rules flag that customer with at least 2 indicators. Otherwise nothing is shared.
Only narrow questions are allowed - "is this masked account flagged, and why?" and "which masked accounts did it send large transfers to or receive them from?"
Answers may contain only masked IDs, bank codes, amount bands, 6-hour time windows, transfer direction and red-flag indicator names.
Names, raw account numbers, addresses, balances, device or IP data, exact amounts and full transaction histories never leave a bank.
A case may follow money at most 3 hops from the starting customer and ask at most 20 questions in total.
